limitations: This receipt proves parity only for the exact hashed ONNX artifact, exact model revision, exact Tether commit, provider and shared input recorded here.
It does not establish task success, training support, hardware deployment readiness or physical safety.

OpenVLA decodes actions by argmax over vocabulary bins, so a single disagreeing action token is a whole-bin error. This receipt requires exact action-token agreement in addition to the continuous-action thresholds; continuous cosine alone would not establish decoder parity.
